title: Efficient Tweakable Zero-Sum PRF Constructions
summary: A simple tweakable zero-sum PRF construction with a security proof is known; optimizing its parameters or finding a more efficient construction remains open.

formal_statement.body: For the tweakable zero-sum pseudorandom-function primitive used by public dummy shuffling, a simple construction with a security proof has been proposed; the unresolved task is to optimize its parameters or develop a new, more efficient construction.

scope.domain: Design and efficiency of tweakable zero-sum pseudorandom functions for public dummy shuffling.
parameters: Parameters of the proposed construction, to be optimized for efficiency
scope.unresolved_remainder: Optimize the proposed construction's parameters or develop a new, more efficient construction.

citations.label: Dummy Shuffling against Algebraic Attacks in White-box Implementations

progress.summary: The source presents a simple construction with a security proof for the tweakable zero-sum PRF used by public dummy shuffling. It explicitly leaves parameter optimization or a more efficient construction as an open question.
citation_labels: Alex Biryukov et al., Dummy Shuffling against Algebraic Attacks in White-box Implementations
